headlines.text: Flash back to 2024, when Samoa Joe vs. Dustin Rhodes met in an Eliminator Match, topping the bill that night on Dynamite, rated 6.46.

On a Wednesday in 2024, back when Adam Copeland vs. Penta El Zero M fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.84. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
Looking back to 2024, when Anthony Ogogo stepped back through the curtain after a long-awaited absence after just under 3 years away, appearing on Dynamite.
